notes.title: 7/21 Update
notes.notes:
This update introduces diagonally-moving lasers! Be on the lookout for obstacles that start high and go low.

You can also find a preview of an upcoming feature. Look for the "Disco" button on the "Studio" tab in the menu.

notes.title: 7/15 Afternoon Patch
notes.notes:
First, an update on the analog stick issue. It seems that some players are able to use the analog stick as intended and that it may be a client-side issue (with myself being the client facing troubles!). Because of that, I'm moving it to a lower priority on the to-do list.

Regardless, I do recommend using the D-Pad to control the game for the sake of precision. But I also want the left analog stick to at least be functional. 

At the moment the biggest issue is: when you leave the tutorial and go to the Tour mode, the lasers don't move. Fixing this is the priority. If you face this issue, it can be temporarily resolved on your end by restarting the game (not ideal, I know). 

With that out of the way, I do have a new "feature" to report: camera resetting! Press R3 (controller) or C (keyboard) to move the camera back to the original position.

Thank you for your feedback and your support.

notes.title: 7/14 Evening Patch
notes.notes:
The annoying pop-up has been replaced by text labels on various parts of the menu.

The post-tutorial bug with non-functioning lasers is still being worked on, as is left analog stick functionality.

notes.title: 7/14 Afternoon Patch
notes.notes:
A bug preventing game progression has been fixed.

There are still some more reported bugs that need to be taken care of:

[olist]
The "Tutorial Time" pop-up keeps popping up
Lasers not working correctly post-tutorial unless the player restarts the game
[/olist]

Thanks for playing!
